verdict.rationale: There is no documented export feature. The evidence shows only indirect ways to get data out: the Weave Service API offers REST endpoints for programmatic access, backed by a published OpenAPI spec, and the MCP server can read traces, evaluations and artifacts. OTel support is documented only as import into Weave, not export out of it. missing for 10: a documented bulk or full-account export, explicit open export formats (e.g. OTLP, JSONL, Parquet), coverage of all data types (traces, evaluations, datasets, scorers), migration or offboarding guidance, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
